title: Don`t Set The Rules For Her
author: Diptirekha Das
text:
Don`t draw a line for me
I`m afraid I can`t promise you
Not to go beyond that line.

Don`t put a puzzle around me.
I`m afraid I may disappoint you
By defying to take chances.

Don`t set the rules for me
I`m afraid I can`t give you my word
To follow them blindly.

Don`t push everything
to the edge dear.
I`m afraid I may start to doubt
our unequivocal bond.

Don`t acquiesce to a wider gulf
between us.
I`m afraid I may fail
to bridge that gap.

Let the old enamoured feelings
Reign between us.
To say,
Just set her free
Don`t clip her wings.

Trust her,
Despite her desire to fly,
She`ll keep coming back to her nest.
Eventually, at dusk.
